newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude ramps up on back of NYMEX products.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude ramps up on back of NYMEX products.

text.p: Brent crude on the IPE made sharp gains in late trade on the back of an upward surge led by NYMEX products, brokers said.
"The NYMEX products took a long time to get going but once they did they really took off. We're seeing shorts covering stops now and have more upside," one commented.
Dec heating oil on NYMEX traded last up 2.80 cents at 71.05 a gallon.
Dec Brent crude oil traded at 1856 GMT up 77 cents at $23.60 a barrel. Jan lagged a little, gaining some 70 cents to $23.22.
The Dec contract expires at close of trade on Thursday.
"Tomorrow is going to be a very interesting day. We have the API's, the December expiry and probably some more (North Sea) loading programmes," one trader said.
The weekly U.S. statistics from the API were due to be released after markets close on Wednesday. Traders estimate distillates will show a build of 0.5-1.0 million barrels.
